{"consolidated_memory":"**Multiple 401 Storm Incidents in services/auth/token_refresh.py**

TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS in the authentication token refresh path:

**Incident 1: [2026-05-08]**
- File: services/auth/token_refresh.py
- Trigger: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider; access token expires mid-session
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in slice bound
- Signal: Burst of unauthorized responses in access log
- Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 29 days running (metric indicating recovery)
- Fix: Corrected the slice bound and added a property test around it
- PR #1336 on branch fix/401-storm-1

**Incident 2: [2026-05-20]**
- File: services/auth/token_refresh.py
- Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels; access token expires mid-session
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Signal: Burst of unauthorized responses in access log
- Result: Cold start performance degraded by 29 percent, dropping to 88 ms
- Fix: Invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
- PR #9514 on branch fix/401-storm-2

Both incidents occurred in the same section of the authentication service (services/auth/token_refresh.py) with the same symptom (401 storm), but with distinct root causes and different triggers. Earlier context from prior work in this code section carried over to both fixes."}
